title: Yes Bank Wellness Plus credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Wellness Plus variant delivering elevated rewards on medical and wellness categories, milestone bonuses, and premium health-focused privileges.

benefitRows.name: Health & Wellness
benefitRows.offer: Receive 12 complimentary fitness sessions monthly, covering Yoga, Zumba, and Gym access, along with complimentary dental and eye checkups annually, preventive health checkups yearly, and unlimited consultations with specialists, nutritionists, and practitioners.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, enroll in the YES Bank Wellness Plus program linked with your credit card. You receive 12 complimentary monthly fitness sessions covering Yoga, Zumba, and Gym access. Additionally, enjoy annual dental and eye checkups, preventive health checkups, and unlimited consultations with health specialists. Contact YES Bank customer care at 1800 120 1221.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Life insurance covers 1 Crore in case of death due to flight accidents.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, report the incident to YES BANK Customer Care at 1800 103 6000 or 022 4935 0000. For email support, contact yesfirstcc@yesbank.in
